import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess
release_root = pathlib.Path('/Users/kevintruong/project/SpurCode/docs/research/artifacts/2026-11-17-duckdb-release')
final_receipt = json.loads((release_root / 'root-final.json').read_text())
current_binary = release_root / 'native-osx-arm64/spur_graph.duckdb_extension'
current_sidecar = pathlib.Path(str(current_binary) + '.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(current_binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == final_receipt['package']['binary']['sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(current_sidecar.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == final_receipt['manifest_sha256']
assert final_receipt['native_source_inputs'] == 321
assert final_receipt['release_tests']['tests_run'] == 206
assert final_receipt['release_tests']['release_pass'] and final_receipt['release_tests']['skipped'] == 0
native_check = subprocess.run([
    '/private/tmp/spur-graph-duckdb-v2-20261114/bin/python',
    '/Users/kevintruong/project/SpurCode/crates/spur-graph-duckdb/scripts/verify_package.py',
    str(current_binary),
], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert native_check.returncode == 0, native_check.stderr
native_result = json.loads(native_check.stdout)
assert native_result['live_readiness']['status'] == 'verified_now'
print(json.dumps({'current_package_sha256': final_receipt['package']['binary']['sha256'], 'native_source_inputs': 321, 'release_tests': final_receipt['release_tests'], 'fresh_native_package_verification': native_result}, indent=2))
